title: Modern Ethiopian Tibs Bowl
community: Modern Addis Ababa restaurants — the bowl format
author: Chef Haile
desc: Modern Ethiopian Tibs Bowl — berbere-seared beef tibs over teff injera pieces, topped with ayib, silsi, pickled jalapeños, and fresh herbs. The contemporary Ethiopian bowl format — deconstructed traditional tibs for the modern restaurant table.
longDesc: The tibs bowl is the modern Ethiopian restaurant's response to the bowl food trend — traditional tibs deconstructed and assembled in the global bowl format but using entirely Ethiopian ingredients.
steps: Make tibs: sear beef in kibbeh with berbere, onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato. Season.
Layer torn injera in a bowl.
Add ayib mound on one side.
chefTips: The ayib and silsi are not mixed — guests combine as they eat.
Hot tibs on torn injera softens it — this is intentional.
commonMistakes: Mixing everything before serving — presentation is the point.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian highland beef and fresh local ingredients.
culturalNote: The tibs bowl is Addis Ababa's response to the global bowl food trend — the same tibs that Ethiopians have eaten for centuries, presented in a format that connects with a generation that grew up eating both injera and global food. It is tradition wearing contemporary clothing.
